card.desc: The weight under a cut, a body hitting the ground, a title card landing.
card.prompt: one single heavy low-frequency thud, a large sandbag dropped onto a wooden stage floor, fast attack, short decay, dry, close microphone, no reverb, silence before and after
card.negative: music, melody, rhythm, speech, tonal, reverb, echo, repeating
card.note: One bed gives you the low thud ONLY. A film impact is a thud plus a crack plus a tail; generate metal_clang or glass_break as a second bed and AudioMerge them. Fights dialogue at 100-250 Hz, so duck the bed under lines rather than turning it down everywhere. Trim the head so the attack is on your cut frame - the model does not put the transient at t=0 reliably.

evidence.method: nothing has checked this card against pixels
